bibliographic.title: phosphenes and floaters
bibliographic.author: skies
bibliographic.description:
how are you supposed to make sense of whatever it is you are?

something is calling to you. you respond, but it sounds all jumbled. everyone around looks at you oddly.

you try responding to it as if it is poetry instead. they like this better. maybe this is fine.
